title: Plane geometry: area and angles
observableEvidence: Computes the area of a composite plane figure by subtracting a rectangular cutout and states square units.

masteryCheckRule: Require one independent straight-line angle solution with the subtraction and equal split shown and one delayed check that finds a rectangular composite area by subtraction and states the correct square units.
